Class Backpack

java.lang.Object
model.Backpack
public class Backpack extends Object
Represents the player's backpack grid. The backpack is a fixed-size grid that can contain items of various shapes. It manages item placement, removal, gold and mana aggregation, locked cells, and mana connectivity between items.

  • Method Details

    • fuseGoldInBag

      public boolean fuseGoldInBag(int value)
      Attempts to merge a specified amount of gold into the gold items in the backpack. It iterates over all gold items (ID = 2) in the backpack. If an item's value is greater than the remaining amount to merge, it adds the value to that gold item. Otherwise, it consumes the gold item and continues with the remaining amount.
      Parameters:
      value - the amount of gold to merge
      Returns:
      true if the full value was merged, false if there was not enough gold
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if nb is not positive

    • subGoldInBag

      public void subGoldInBag(int value)
      Subtracts a specified amount of gold from the gold items in the backpack. It iterates over all gold items (ID = 2) in the backpack. If an item's value is greater than the remaining amount to subtract, it decreases the item's value. Otherwise, it removes the gold item completely and continues with the remaining amount.
      Parameters:
      value - the amount of gold to subtract
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if nb is not positive

    • inBackpack

      public boolean inBackpack(int x, int y)
      Checks whether a given coordinate is outside the backpack grid. The backpack is represented as a 2D array, where (0,0) is the top-left corner. This method returns true if the coordinates are invalid (outside the grid), and false if they are within bounds.
      Parameters:
      x - the column index to check
      y - the row index to check
      Returns:
      true if the coordinate is outside the backpack, false otherwise

    • addItemToBackpack

      public boolean addItemToBackpack(Item item)
      Add an item in the backpack of the game. If item is null, it means that we just press the button for adding.
